p: A skim is a thin finishing coat, a few millimetres thick, over walls that are basically sound. It gives a smooth surface ready for paint. Replastering means hacking off old, blown or crumbling plaster back to the brick and starting again, which costs more and takes longer to dry. See skimming and replastering in Leeds for prices.

Checkatrade's 2026 guide puts skimming a medium room of about 3m by 3m at £430 to £550, typically £480, and plastering the same room from scratch at about £755. A typical plasterer day rate is about £300. Skimming a medium ceiling is about £360.

Many Artex and textured ceilings in Leeds homes built before 2000 may contain asbestos. Do not sand or scrape them until a sample has been tested. A plasterer can often skim over a sound textured ceiling without disturbing it. See Artex ceiling removal and asbestos surveys in Leeds.

New plaster changes from dark pink to pale pink as it dries. Thin skim coats can dry in a few days, while a full replaster can take weeks. Use a mist coat of thinned emulsion first. See painters and decorators in Leeds for the next step.

guide.h2: Rendering, coving and other plastering services
p: As well as skimming walls and ceilings, many plasterers in Leeds offer external rendering, patch repairs, coving and plasterboarding for loft conversions and new builds. Rendering is a different skill from internal plastering, so ask to see recent rendering jobs. Most domestic plastering jobs across Leeds and West Yorkshire are quoted per room, so measure up or send photos to get a quick price.

guide.h2: Plastering services across Leeds and Yorkshire
p: Every plasterer in Leeds on our list covers the city and the surrounding areas, and some work further across West Yorkshire. Whether it is one plastering job or a full renovation, most homeowners want the same thing: a smooth finish that is ready to decorate and a tradesperson who leaves the room clean. Ask Leeds plasterers for photos of similar work and check reviews that mention the type of job you need. If the plastering is part of a bigger project, such as a new bathroom, ask whether the plasterer can work around your bathroom fitter or builder. Good professional plasterers will be honest about whether your walls need a skim or a full replaster, so the job is done right first time.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to skim a room in Leeds?
faqs.a: Checkatrade's 2026 guide gives £430 to £550 for a medium room of about 3m by 3m, typically £480, plus VAT where charged.

faqs.q: How long does it take to plaster a room?
faqs.a: Skimming an average room usually takes a day. A full replaster, including hacking off old plaster, can take two to three days before drying.

faqs.q: How long before I can paint new plaster?
faqs.a: Wait until it is evenly pale and fully dry, then apply a mist coat. Thin skims can be ready in a few days; thicker plaster takes longer.
